changelog.title: Changelog
changelog.description: The latest updates and improvements from Reach.

v135.title: v1.3.5 — More flexible templates, faster audiences, and consistent data
v135.description: A release focused on speeding up work with large audiences and keeping template and contact information in sync.

templateEditing.title: WhatsApp Template Editing
templateEditing.description: Update compatible templates directly from Reach with a safer workflow.
templateEditing.feature1: Preload existing content so you can edit without starting over
templateEditing.feature2: Sync changes with Twilio first to prevent inconsistencies
templateEditing.feature3: Clearly identify fields and buttons that need corrections

audiencePerformance.title: Faster Audiences and Campaigns
audiencePerformance.description: Navigation stays responsive even with large contact volumes.
audiencePerformance.feature1: Optimized pagination for contacts, list members, and campaign members
audiencePerformance.feature2: Status filters help find campaign members quickly
audiencePerformance.feature3: Selections and counts remain accurate when changing pages

contactReliability.title: Easier Contact Imports and Management
contactReliability.description: Contact information is validated and updated more consistently.
contactReliability.feature1: Import E.164 phone numbers with or without the + sign
contactReliability.feature2: Phone numbers are normalized automatically before being saved
contactReliability.feature3: Deletes and edits immediately update lists, counts, and views

v133.title: v1.3.3 — More flexible conversations and better performance
v133.description: A release focused on making outbound conversations easier and improving Reach's overall performance.

outboundConversations.title: More Flexible Outbound Conversations
outboundConversations.description: Start WhatsApp conversations more easily from Reach.
outboundConversations.feature1: Use approved templates to start a conversation
outboundConversations.feature2: Choose an existing contact or enter a phone number manually

templateReliability.title: Template Management Improvements
templateReliability.description: Creating and using templates now includes clearer validation and a more consistent workflow.
templateReliability.feature1: Configure buttons, phone numbers, and links with more clarity
templateReliability.feature2: Get clearer feedback when a template needs corrections
templateReliability.feature3: Update templates and senders easily from the application

performance.title: Performance and Stability Improvements
performance.description: Reach responds faster and more efficiently during everyday tasks.
performance.feature1: Faster searches across contacts, lists, and campaigns
performance.feature3: Better responsiveness when working with large volumes of information

v132.title: v1.3.2 — PWA, campaign archival, and faster imports
v132.description: A hotfix release that makes Reach installable as a native app, adds campaign member archival for large audiences, and eliminates import timeouts and deadlocks.

pwaSupport.title: Installable Progressive Web App
pwaSupport.description: Reach is now installable as a native app on desktop and mobile, with offline support and quick-access shortcuts.
pwaSupport.feature1: Install prompt and loading screen for an app-like experience
pwaSupport.feature2: Offline screen and iOS safe area handling for consistent layouts
pwaSupport.feature3: App shortcuts to jump directly to campaigns and inbox

importPerformance.title: Faster, Safer Contact Imports
importPerformance.description: Bulk imports of 10K+ contacts are now 3–5x faster and no longer hit statement timeouts or deadlocks.
importPerformance.feature1: Compact response payload reduces transfer from ~1.14 MB to ~138 bytes per batch
importPerformance.feature2: Eliminated statement timeouts on imports of 10K+ contacts
importPerformance.feature3: Fixed deadlock in the campaign metrics queue trigger during concurrent webhook processing
importPerformance.feature4: Atomic import claiming and per-batch checkpoints prevent duplicate work on resume

v131.title: v1.3.1 — Reliability and workflow improvements
v131.description: A release focused on smoother audience workflows, stronger template management, and more reliable campaign message processing.

templateBuilder.title: More Flexible Template Buttons
templateBuilder.description: Create WhatsApp templates with more flexible button combinations and clearer validation.
templateBuilder.feature1: Button types and fields are validated consistently
templateBuilder.feature2: Changing a button type resets incompatible fields safely
templateBuilder.feature3: The initial template synchronization flow is more reliable for existing organizations

audienceUpdates.title: Automatic Audience Updates
audienceUpdates.description: Contacts, lists, and segments now stay in sync while you work.
audienceUpdates.feature1: Contact imports update the list with optimistic feedback
audienceUpdates.feature2: New lists are reflected automatically after an import
audienceUpdates.feature3: Segment caching and refetching reduce stale results

webhookProcessing.title: More Reliable Message Processing
webhookProcessing.description: Campaign callbacks are processed through a more resilient queue and reconciliation flow.
webhookProcessing.feature1: Webhook callbacks are routed by organization
webhookProcessing.feature2: Stuck messages are reconciled against Twilio automatically
webhookProcessing.feature3: Queue processing supports configurable concurrency and larger batches

exportPerformance.title: Optimized Report Export
exportPerformance.description: CSV exports for large campaigns now complete without timeouts, supporting up to 500k contacts per campaign.
exportPerformance.feature1: Batched pagination with an optimized index for high-volume campaigns
exportPerformance.feature2: Twilio error resolution moved to the database for faster downloads
